exposure: being born in a developed country
IBD subtype (ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease)
having more than 1 bathroom at home
finding: Early life and childhood environmental exposures were associated with younger age of IBD diagnosis in both Hispanic and non-Hispanic White individuals, and a cumulative environmental risk score was more strongly associated with age of IBD diagnosis than genetic risk score.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a younger age of IBD diagnosis.
